description: Append the selected Media Pool clip to the end of the timeline (Edit > Append to End of Timeline).
user_action_prompt: In DaVinci's Media Pool, click the clip you want to append. Then continue.

steps.script:
tell application "System Events"
tell process "DaVinci Resolve"
click menu item "Append to End of Timeline" of menu "Edit" of menu bar 1
end tell
end tell
